description: Tailor these completion criteria to the production's contracted scope. Omit or explicitly dismiss confirmed non-applicable work; missing information is unverified, not non-applicable.

tasks.title: Confirm rental and vehicle returns
tasks.done_when: Each used supplier has acknowledged returns; discrepancies, loss, damage and late charges are resolved or assigned explicitly.

tasks.title: Close out wardrobe, props and art purchases
tasks.done_when: Returns, retained items, disposal and refunds are accounted for with the responsible department; applicability is confirmed.

tasks.title: Confirm used locations are restored and released
tasks.done_when: Identify which booked/scouted locations were used; obtain site sign-off and resolve restoration, damage, keys and access obligations.

tasks.title: Resolve deposits, damage and insurance claims
tasks.done_when: Refundable deposits and any loss/damage claims have documented dispositions; do not assume there were deposits or claims.

tasks.title: Verify final timecards and crew costs
tasks.done_when: Confirm all worked days, overtime, meal penalties and agreed adjustments are submitted and approved against the actual crew roster.

tasks.title: Close crew reimbursements and petty cash
tasks.done_when: Crew expense receipts, petty-cash advances, mileage/per diem and any outstanding balances are reconciled as applicable.

tasks.title: Verify final payroll and resolve crew issues
tasks.done_when: Payroll batches, worker coverage, adjustments and outstanding crew concerns are verified; a single paid payroll invoice is insufficient.

tasks.title: Verify required releases and rights paperwork
tasks.done_when: Required talent/appearance, location/property and material releases are signed and filed for the agreed use; missing clearances have an owner.

tasks.title: Archive final production agreements and reports
tasks.done_when: Applicable crew/vendor/location agreements, permits, insurance certificates and production reports are collected in the wrap package.

tasks.title: Confirm union and other required closeout paperwork
tasks.done_when: Determine applicability first, then verify any required union, minor, permit or incident closeout documents with the responsible production lead.

tasks.title: Verify footage and sound inventory and backups
tasks.done_when: The media lead confirms all shoot media is accounted for and backups are verified under the job's agreed storage/retention plan.

tasks.title: Confirm media and reports were accepted by post
tasks.done_when: The named post recipient acknowledges receipt of required footage, sound, camera/sound reports and supporting materials; unresolved pickups are identified.

tasks.title: Confirm post-production scope and remaining handover obligations
tasks.done_when: Record who owns post and delivery. If in our scope, track agreed edits, reviews, clearances and delivery acceptance; otherwise document the accepted production-to-post handoff.

tasks.title: Collect final invoices, receipts and credits
tasks.done_when: Confirm supplier final invoices, expense receipts, refunds and credits are captured; request missing documents without assuming the current ledger is exhaustive.

tasks.title: Resolve outstanding vendor invoices
tasks.done_when: Review each balance and approval issue, then verify supported settlement applications; keep disputed or unknown balances explicit.

tasks.title: Reconcile payments, refunds and invoice applications
tasks.done_when: Bank/project allocations, AP/AR applications and supporting evidence are reconciled separately; unapplied payments are not additional debt.

tasks.title: Reconcile budget lines and review exceptions
tasks.done_when: Every in-scope budget line, source cost and job-tagged transaction has been reviewed; each tagged transaction traces to source-budget Actuals or a documented reviewed exception, including refunds; unassigned receipt-charge candidates and separate tips have also been checked; Actuals reconcile to evidence, remaining commitments and payment/refund applications have a disposition, and variances and client overages are resolved or explicitly accepted with evidence and an owner. A nonzero cost or variance alone is not an exception. Missing evidence remains unverified.

tasks.title: Prepare and review the final production actual
tasks.done_when: Use the budget-line reconciliation review to confirm the approved scope, final costs, commitments, fees and fringes; obtain final financial review without double counting alternative or composite bids.

tasks.title: Resolve final client billing and receipts
tasks.done_when: Review draft/issued invoices against approved scope and overages; resolve overlapping drafts, confirm intended issuance and reconcile receipts. Drafts alone do not prove money is owed.

tasks.title: Deliver the production wrap package
tasks.done_when: The agreed recipient receives the final actual and required production documents/reports through approved access; private crew/payroll details remain restricted.

tasks.title: Obtain wrap sign-off and assign remaining obligations
tasks.done_when: The responsible production lead reviews closeout, accepts the handover and records owners for any expressly accepted exceptions; project closure is a separate action.
